title: STARTEX — Rainy Evening Commute, Larkfield County

fields.location: Larkfield County, Wisconsin: Brandt Lake and the Highway 21 corridor
fields.weather: Dusk, steady rain, 46°F. Wet roads, poor visibility.
fields.load: Heavy evening commute on Highway 21. CAD shows 4 pending calls, all routine.
fields.staffing: Normal evening staffing at the Larkfield County Communications Center, Supervisor Keiko Tanaka on duty
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 17:30 on Thursday, November 12, 2026. It is dusk and raining steadily, and the evening commute is heavy on Highway 21. The Larkfield County Communications Center has normal evening staffing with four routine calls pending. Larkfield Regional Medical Center has 21 of its 24 ED beds full because of a respiratory surge, and St. Brendan's Community Hospital in Pell Harbor is on Limited intake because its CT scanner is down. All radio channels and the MEDCOM capacity board are working. Status is normal. Confirm your role, your radio channel and where you will record your decisions.

fields.facilitatorNote: Before reading, make sure each table has its role briefing, a decision log and the channel plan (LARK DISP 1 dispatch, LARK CMD 2 command, LARK TAC 3 tactical, MED 1 hospitals). After reading, have MEDCOM read back the four hospital statuses and DISP name the units available countywide.
fields.scenarioTitle: Open on Paper — Hospital Capacity Board & MCI Patient Flow

instructorNote: This card sets the starting conditions. Check that every player confirms their role, radio channel and decision log, that MEDCOM records the starting hospital statuses (LRMC 21/24, St. Brendan's Limited intake) and that DISP takes a count of available units. These baselines are needed later to spot the stale capacity board.
